verification_points.title: Targeted regression: Effective ehco_sid release
verification_points.requirement: A valid ehco_sid, a correct Authorization: Bearer <ApiToken>, or X-Ehco-Token equal to ApiToken grants access. Expired or unknown SIDs grant no access, and an incorrect token returns 401. When authRequired is false, protected routes reach their handlers without authentication. The public routes are /, /index.html, both favicon routes, robots, /assets/, and the three auth endpoints. Other routes requiring authentication return 401 authentication required. auth_required describes the configuration and authenticated describes the request. Handle the open and token-only branches first, as in the baseline. With a configured password, invalid JSON returns 400 invalid login body and a mismatched password in valid JSON returns 401 invalid password. With empty DashboardPass and nonempty ApiToken, return 403 dashboard login not configured and issue no session. A successful password login returns 200 authenticated:true and sets ehco_sid with Path=/, HttpOnly, Strict SameSite, Secure according to TLS, and the existing expiry. With both credentials empty, return authenticated:true without parsing the password or issuing a new session via Set-Cookie. Logout revokes a supplied session and clears the cookie even if the session is missing. The old session then becomes invalid. Preserve the seven-day TTL, delete expired SIDs and deny them access, extend stored expiry to now+TTL after successful validation, and resend the renewed cookie on protected requests.
verification_points.mutation: Targeted regression: Effective ehco_sid release (changed files: internal/web/auth.go)
